scope: General SO4 ligand-state and zero-added-hydrogen preparation defects found in the frozen 4HHY full-preparation case. No MD performed; no claim of microscopic protonation prediction or universal sulfate force-field validity.

diagnosis.reason_not_to_restore_symmetric_maps: The output is a neutralized sulfuric-acid graph at pH 7, not merely an unlabeled sulfate graph; recovering maps alone would propagate the wrong declared source state.

fix.state_policy: For component SO4 at pH 6–8, retain the already-matching CCD sulfate dianion graph as an explicit fixed reference-state choice. Preserve all atom identities, bonds, charges and coordinates; do not invoke the pH heuristic or recover maps. A user-mapped override takes precedence. Other graphs or pH values require an explicit state.
fix.policy_limit: The 6–8 interval is a conservative application policy, not a prediction of bound sulfate/bisulfate populations.
fix.zero_hydrogen_policy: If RDKit adds no hydrogen atoms, return the labeled copy with all original coordinates. There are no movable coordinates, so skip the all-fixed force field minimizer that raised a BFGS invariant violation.
fix.unused_global_14_scale_policy: Only when no proper torsion parameter types and no shortest bond-graph-distance-three atom pairs exist, populate otherwise unused generic XML defaults from ParmEd AmberParameterSet (SCEE 1.2, SCNB 2). Preserve all actual interaction parameters. Record graph proof and before/after defaults, and require unchanged native energy/force validation.

test_evidence.coverage: Reference-state preservation at pH 6,7,8; range/graph rejection; override precedence; ordinary heuristic path for another component; sulfate and non-sulfate zero-H optimizer bypass; normal H-only relaxation retains heavy atoms.

test_evidence.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q backend/tests/test_sulfate_state.py backend/tests/test_ligands.py -k 'sulfate or hydrogen or global_14 or torsion_parameters or graph_14'
test_evidence.coverage: Also proves no scale normalization for an actual shortest-distance-three graph or existing proper torsion parameters.

attempts.outcome: Eligibility failed because the ordinary pH heuristic lost symmetric sulfate oxygen maps.
State eligibility passed and 15R native ligand conversion passed; full preparation failed at RDKit all-fixed hydrogen relaxation for sulfate. This failure is retained, not reclassified as a pass.

Sulfate and 15R native Amber conversions both passed; full preparation failed when the isolated sulfate XML used generic global 1–4 scales 1/1, conflicting with Amber protein and 15R scales. No prepared result was published.

Passed full preparation in 115.36 seconds with stable backend source. Both native Amber conversions passed, the 8-residue loop and serialized PDB geometry passed, the full mixed force field reconstructed, and static energy was finite. All 48 source ligand heavy atoms are present with exactly zero saved-PDB coordinate displacement.
